Samples of the public job-board APIs.

- `greenhouse.json`, `lever.json`, `ashby.json`, `smartrecruiters.json`, `adzuna.json`: fictional, shaped like the
  real responses checked on 2026-11-03 (moved from `backend/tests/fixtures/sources/`). Companies, people and links
  are made up.
- `workday_search_all.json`, `workday_search_india.json`, `workday_detail.json`: real public responses from
  NVIDIA's Workday career site (2026-11-14), trimmed: two or three postings, a few facet values, the first
  paragraphs of one description. Public job data only.
